_comment: RAG retrieval golden set — queries grounded in the user's real repos (ai-applications, cdk-monitoring) + JD requirements. `expectedRepos`/`expectedFiles` drive deterministic recall@k; the LLM judge scores context-relevance per retrieved chunk. `kind:'negative'` queries SHOULD score low relevance (honest-gap signal). Refine freely; versioned so regressions are visible.
